title: Managed Backup: portfolio discount
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines portfolio discount.

## Tier basis

**Portfolio usage threshold.** Same-category posted pre-discount usage subtotal required within one billing entity and month for volume discount; USD decimal.

**Portfolio discount fraction.** Discount fraction when the portfolio threshold is met; decimal.

| Contract tier | Portfolio usage threshold | Portfolio discount fraction |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | 25000 | 0.025 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | 25000 | 0.03 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | 25000 | 0.035 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 50 TB | 25000 | 0.04 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 100 TB | 25000 | 0.045 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 250 TB | 25000 | 0.05 |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, portfolio discount fraction is 0.025.

## Hypothetical comparison

For a hypothetical choice between the smallest and largest listed tiers, portfolio discount fraction differs: 0.025 for the smallest and 0.05 for the largest.
